best_language.description: A language Gef can use as one of the learner's strongest explanation/comparison languages for this lesson.
best_language.registry_requirement: The language tag must exist in registry/language-support.json programs.learnFromLanguages.
best_language.notes: The rendering supplies lesson-wide wording in the best language. The comparison record supplies that language's own forms and ownGrammarBlurb. If a required asset exists below the user's trust threshold, keep the language visible but unavailable at that threshold.

learning_language_comparison.description: A language that can participate as a learning/target language in the comparison portion without rule-driven practice.
learning_language_comparison.registry_requirement: The language identity must be recognized by the product registry; lesson tier alone does not grant support.
learning_language_comparison.notes: This is enough to show how the language realizes the semantic territory, but not enough to claim complete grammar instruction.

learning_language_full.description: A language this lesson can actively teach with structured rules and defensible practice.
learning_language_full.registry_requirement: The language identity must be recognized by the product registry.
required_assets: at least one structured grammar form
learning_language_full.notes: Full support never follows automatically from the product-wide language tier.

trust_visibility.effective_language_trust: Minimum trust state among the required assets for that language in the requested role.
trust_visibility.effective_lesson_trust: Minimum trust state among all artifacts actually rendered in the current lesson session.
trust_visibility.notes: A teacher using Verified-only mode should still be able to see that a known language exists. If its lesson assets are only Beta/Reviewed or incomplete, show it disabled with the appropriate badge/status instead of silently hiding it.

full.description: The lesson has structured grammar forms/rules for this language and may render GrammarRuleBlock/practice from Lexicon data.

comparison_only.description: The lesson may render the language comparison/example block when a real comparison record exists, but must not imply complete rule coverage or generate rule-driven practice for this language.

unavailable.description: No defensible lesson comparison data exists yet. Keep a product-known language discoverable in selection UI, but do not invent lesson data.

pending_full_support_research.reason: Tier 1/2 expectation only. These languages remain comparison_only for this lesson until structured grammar records for this concept are researched, added to the grammar set, and the full-support flag is deliberately promoted.

promotion_rules: Global language tier never grants lesson-level full support automatically.
Any registered language, including a reading-led language, may be promoted to full for this lesson when this lesson's structured grammar records are ready.

A full-support language must exist in the referenced grammar set, be lesson_ready, contain at least one form and at least one structured rule, and be explicitly listed in support_levels.full.language_tags.

A comparison_only language becomes renderable when the dedicated comparison-record catalog contains actual forms/constructions. own_grammar_blurb is required before the language qualifies as a complete best-language explanation path.

English and Spanish are reference-anchor candidates, not unconditional fixed languages. The runtime may inject one forms-only anchor when neither is already part of the learner's displayed profile languages.

An injected reference anchor uses the best-language rendering's short reference_anchor_explainers entry, never the anchor's full own_grammar_blurb unless that anchor is one of the learner's real profile languages.
Removing or downgrading a language must be explicit; do not infer capability from global tier changes.
